images.caption: This is one segment of Grant Road, NW, Washington D.C., located one block from the original location of Fort Kearny. The road was originally constructed in 1862 by the 15th NJVI to connect the forts constructed for the defense of Washington, D.C.. Originally known as New Military Road, small sections such as this still exist as alleyways scattered along the route of the original construction.

images.caption:
A grassy field leading to two tower structures on a cloudy day.
Civil War Defenses of Washington is located in Washington D.C. and was added to the Network in 2019. This site interprets the experiences of Civil War Washington, including in the city's many camps for formerly enslaved people and Freedman communities.
